shots.title: Define roadmap migrate dry-run, repair-plan, audit, and mapping contracts (#589)

hazards.description: The first applicable contract did not prove that strict target sources could parse and compile without semantic drift.

shots.notes: The final plan is source-bound, target-schema-valid, and binds the exact expected compatibility projection digest.

shots.title: Analyze orphan and duplicate ownership, legacy shapes, and non-core top-level fields (#589)
shots.notes: Ownership ambiguity fails closed, bounded legacy shapes are audited, nested fields are preserved, and non-core blocks are exported losslessly.

shots.title: Require explicit ownership mappings for ambiguous repairs and audit bounded normalizations (#589)

hazards.description: Initial phase and scorecard mapping consumption was incomplete, and absent before-values disappeared from serialized audit evidence.

shots.notes: All mappings are now consumed strictly with verified path-safe evidence, and absent values use a durable JSON sentinel.

shots.title: Prove deterministic idempotent migration plans with bounded diagnostics (#589)
shots.notes: A 456-sprint regression proves bounded diagnostics, complete repair templates, stable ordering, and identical hashes across mapping insertion order.

conditions.description: A migration plan must describe legacy repairs while also proving that the strict target representation will preserve the intended projection.

training.description: Planner applicability must mean the consumer can render and validate the exact target, not merely that legacy analysis completed.
training.outcome: The planner validates the target schema and binds the expected compiled projection digest.

training.description: Explicit mappings are an audit boundary and every supplied entry must be used or rejected.
training.outcome: Ownership, ticket, phase-kind, and scorecard mappings now fail closed when stale, unnecessary, unverified, or mismatched.

nutrition.description: One hundred seventeen focused planner, source-federation, and roadmap tests passed after review repair.
TypeScript typecheck passed with the final planner contract.
Independent review rejected five contract gaps; all were repaired and final re-review approved.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Analysis was easy to make descriptive; making it an executable, fidelity-bound contract was the difficult part.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Treat applicable as a guarantee to the writer, and hash the exact compiled artifact the writer must produce.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: A parser that accepted id-only tickets still silently materialized a key during structural casting.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The transaction layer can now consume a plan without guessing or discovering schema failures mid-write.

bunker_locations: Do not declare a migration plan applicable until strict target parsing and cross-reference validation pass.
Preserve authored compatibility aliases through the compiler boundary, not only in the planner object.
Represent absent audit values explicitly; JSON drops undefined object properties.
yardage_book_updates: RoadmapMigrationPlan.expected_projection_sha256 binds the exact strict-compiled compatibility projection.
course_management_notes: Planner implementation and independent review evidence are pushed; the transactional apply sprint remains active and no PR merge or release is implied.
